description: SaunaLife Model Outdoor Sauna G6 | Garden Series Model G6 Fully Assembled Outdoor Sauna Environment The SaunaLife Model Outdoor Sauna G6 from the GARDEN-Series is a fully constructed cabin, designed to provide the ultimate quality and luxury for your outdoor home sauna experience. No assembly is required. Spacious and comfortable Experience ultimate relaxation in the SaunaLife Model G6, a top-of-the-line outdoor sauna designed with premium materials for unbeatable warmth, elegance, and comfort. The rich alder interior boasts two levels of benches, providing optimal comfort for up to 5 bathers. With a spacious interior and a stunning full-wall picture window, bathers can bask in the tranquil outdoors while enjoying the luxurious sauna experience. The side entry door is also equipped with insulated glass, further enhancing the ambiance. From top to bottom, this sauna is crafted to pamper and delight. Impressively robust construction Viewed from any perspective, it is clear that this sauna was constructed with no concessions. The meticulously cut, painted spruce exterior creates a striking contrast with the luxurious alder interior. Insulated walls and double-glazed insulated glass offer superior thermal efficiency. A rainwater system safeguards the G6 model from harsh weather conditions. This is a reputable sauna, designed for long-term personal wellness and wellbeing. Precision-engineered and crafted Crafted with care and expertise by true sauna enthusiasts, the SaunaLife Model G6 is an all-in-one backyard sauna built to perfection. Handmade in Northern Europe, where sauna bathing is practiced by millions for its health benefits, this sauna features an insulated glass door framed in striking black wood and a sleek black aluminum door handle. With no visible fasteners, the interior exudes a professional, polished appearance from every angle. Beautifully illuminated Add a peaceful touch to your sauna experience with the soothing natural wood and subtle LED lighting. The G6 model offers a waterproof, low-voltage white LED system that can be controlled through a Wi-Fi app for effortless ambiance. A hand-held remote is also included for easy on/off/dim operation. This SaunaLife model meets heat and water certification standards (IP67) and has dotless LEDs for a sleek, modern look. Timeless beauty The SaunaLife G6 combines form and function for a stunning addition to any home. Its elegant design and classic lines make it a perfect fit for any style home. Crafted with attention to detail and high-quality materials, this sauna cabin is a true testament to skilled craftsmanship and careful planning. Indulge in a lifetime of physical and mental wellness with SaunaLife Model Outdoor Sauna G6 | Garden Series, the perfect addition to your outdoor sanctuary.
